subject: 安岳毗卢洞水月观音（紫竹观音）
caption: 安岳石刻 · 毗卢洞水月观音
宋代 · 紫竹观音游戏坐
author: Nekitarc

sources.author: Nekitarc
sources.role: 真实雕像近正面照，原始像素724×771；下载服务放大为1280宽参考

source_note: 逐一核对右膝翘起、右手垂于右膝、左手撑坐台、左脚落莲台的非对称游戏坐。只取主尊及坐台、莲台、头光与少量竹枝，不虚构石窟全景。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line heritage sculpture illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: the WATER-MOON GUANYIN 水月观音, commonly Purple Bamboo Guanyin 紫竹观音, in PILU CAVE 毗卢洞, Anyue County, Sichuan. Image 2 is the actual photographed sculpture and defines all anatomy, pose, garments, headdress, pedestal and halo. DRAW ONLY THE LARGE CENTRAL SEATED GUANYIN, with its curved rock seat and lotus footrest, a delicate circular head halo and just two or three fine bamboo stalk contours immediately behind. Exclude the many small surrounding carved figures, inscription panels and cave walls. Keep the exact asymmetric 'royal ease' posture from the photograph, never substitute crossed lotus legs: the deity's RIGHT leg (on VIEWER LEFT) is bent and raised, its knee high, bare right foot rests sideways on the seat. Its RIGHT elbow rests on that raised right knee and the right hand hangs down loosely over the knee. The deity's LEFT leg (on VIEWER RIGHT) descends toward the front, left bare foot resting on the small lotus footrest at lower center. Its LEFT arm is almost straight down beside its torso, left palm presses on the seat at viewer right, supporting the slightly tilted body. Exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. Head almost frontal with gentle downward eyes, tapered jeweled crown, draping ribbons at ears, chest necklaces and long skirt following the actual photo. Preserve relaxed subtly leaning shoulders and dignified tranquil expression. The broad curved seat projects beneath the seated figure; simplify fringed fabric to 6-10 long folds, do NOT densely hatch every tassel. Selective delicate necklace contours, not a dense field of beads. White empty face, limbs and garment surfaces with the restrained line density of Image 1. Do NOT copy the Buddha's upright symmetrical pose from the style master. Complete full crown, head halo, both hands, both feet, curved seat and small lotus footrest. Portrait 1024×1536, figure centered occupying about 78% canvas height, generous clean white margin; NO cave architecture, labels, black masses, stipple, shading, gradients, color or pattern-filled surfaces.

historical_sources.title: 毗卢洞
historical_sources.publisher: 安岳县文化广播电视和旅游局
historical_sources.evidence: 毗卢洞位于石羊镇油坪村龙归山；造像开凿于两宋延至明清；水月观音又称紫竹观音，侧坐并翘起右脚。

historical_sources.title: 故宫博物院关于紫竹观音及竹与佛教图像的文章
historical_sources.evidence: 毗卢洞观音殿水月观音约高三米，开凿于宋代；左手托撑山石，右手置膝，称自在坐或游戏坐。

site_recommendation.lede: 一膝翘起，一手轻撑石台。毗卢洞的水月观音以舒展的游戏坐，把宋代石刻的从容留在岩壁上。

facts.label: 所绘主尊
facts.text: 毗卢洞水月观音，俗称紫竹观音；并非安岳石刻全景。

facts.label: 游戏坐
facts.text: 右膝屈起，右手垂膝；左手撑台，左足下垂于莲台，姿态舒展。

facts.label: 两宋遗珍
facts.text: 毗卢洞造像开凿于两宋，延续至明清，2001年列入第五批全国重点文物保护单位。
